 N- All you're going to do is saute this for around 3-5 minutes until heated through. Then add your cooked pasta and pesto to the pan. You can add some pasta water and season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Now just transfer to a bowl, sprinkle with grated parmesan, and you have an affordable meal. From a nutrition standpoint, this meal could use a little more protein, but it's a great base that's quick, easy, and affordable. Food access and affordability play a huge role in health. Eating well shouldn't just be about perfection. It's about making the best choice you can with what you have. And meals like this show that nourishing yourself doesn't have to be complicated or expensive. So easy and so good.
